metadata.fixture_policy: Audio fixtures are generated as tiny WAV files under each per-test sandbox output directory; no generated audio or SoundBank output may target the immutable SampleProject source.
metadata.sandbox_policy: Each destructive case prepares a fresh Task 3 SampleProject sandbox and launches WwiseConsole only with WWISE_FIXTURE_PROJECT under WWISE_SANDBOX_ROOT.
metadata.source_immutability_hash: source .wproj mtime plus sha256 over mutation-bearing Wwise project files (*.wproj, *.wwu); source generated-output directories are also checked before/after
